page: Microsoft Azure L48s_v3 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor clocked at 2.8 GHz. The system provides 48 vCPUs across 24 dedicated physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, accompanied by 384 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include 48 MB of L3 cache, along with support for AVX-512 vector extensions, VNNI, and cryptographic instruction sets including VAES and AES. There are no discrete GPUs included in this configuration.

A defining element of the L48s_v3 architecture is its integrated local storage, provisioning 12,035 GB of direct-attached NVMe solid-state storage. This local capacity delivers direct I/O throughput without requiring reliance on external network volumes for scratch, cache, or active data sets. Memory bandwidth is substantial, achieving 163.76 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and 70.56 GB/sec on writes, reflected in a strong PassMark memory benchmark score of 2,908.37.

Across general compute benchmarks, the L48s_v3 demonstrates consistent mid-tier performance within its scale class, logging a Geekbench multi-core score of 15,837 and a PassMark CPU score of 48,928.12. It shows elevated capability in specialized tasks, achieving top-quartile results in hardware encryption benchmarks and visual computing tasks such as ray tracing and image processing. High-throughput in-memory data processing is demonstrated by a measured Redis SET throughput of 45.6 million operations per second and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rates of 83.97 GB/sec.

From an efficiency perspective, the L48s_v3 consolidates heavy multi-core CPU capacity, 384 GB of RAM, and more than 12 TB of high-speed local NVMe flash into a single host footprint. The tradeoff for this architecture centers on the ephemeral nature of direct-attached NVMe storage, requiring robust replication patterns to manage node termination or redeployment. Consequently, this server is suitable for high-transaction NoSQL engines, distributed relational databases, search indexing, real-time analytics, and data warehousing workloads requiring massive local cache pools.
description: Microsoft Azure L48s_v3 is a storage-optimized virtual machine featuring 48 vCPUs across 24 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. Equipped with 384 GB of memory and 12,035 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, the instance is engineered for I/O-intensive and data-heavy enterprise tasks. The CPU architecture supports AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, yielding strong scores in hardware encryption and PassMark memory testing. It maintains consistent mid-tier compute results on Geekbench multi-core workloads alongside a Redis throughput of 45.6 million operations per second. While the local NVMe storage provides rapid direct access, it is non-persistent across instance deallocations, necessitating software-level redundancy. The L48s_v3 is well suited for transactional databases, distributed NoSQL systems, search clusters, and large data-processing pipelines requiring substantial local disk cache and high memory capacity.
